mapper.update: UPDATE chart SET status = 'RUNNING', workerId = #{workerId}, leaseExpireTime = DATE_ADD(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), attemptCount = COALESCE(attemptCount, 0) + 1, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) IN ('WAITING', 'WAIT') AND COALESCE(attemptCount, 0) < COALESCE(maxAttempts, 3)

UPDATE chart SET genChart = #{genChart}, genResult = #{genResult}, execMessage = NULL, status = 'SUCCEEDED', workerId = NULL, leaseExpireTime = NULL, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) = 'RUNNING' AND workerId = #{workerId}

UPDATE chart SET execMessage = #{execMessage}, status = 'FAILED', workerId = NULL, leaseExpireTime = NULL, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) = 'RUNNING' AND workerId = #{workerId}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM chart WHERE isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) IN ('WAITING', 'WAIT') AND COALESCE(attemptCount, 0) < COALESCE(maxAttempts, 3) ORDER BY createTime ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, attemptCount, maxAttempts, workerId FROM chart WHERE isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) = 'RUNNING' AND leaseExpireTime IS NOT NULL AND leaseExpireTime < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ORDER BY leaseExpireTime ASC, id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE chart SET status = 'WAITING', workerId = NULL, leaseExpireTime = NULL, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) = 'RUNNING' AND leaseExpireTime IS NOT NULL AND leaseExpireTime < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND COALESCE(attemptCount, 0) < COALESCE(maxAttempts, 3) AND (workerId = #{expectedWorkerId} OR (#{expectedWorkerId} IS NULL AND workerId IS NULL))

UPDATE chart SET status = 'FAILED', workerId = NULL, leaseExpireTime = NULL, execMessage = #{execMessage}, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) = 'RUNNING' AND leaseExpireTime IS NOT NULL AND leaseExpireTime < CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND COALESCE(attemptCount, 0) >= COALESCE(maxAttempts, 3) AND (workerId = #{expectedWorkerId} OR (#{expectedWorkerId} IS NULL AND workerId IS NULL))

UPDATE chart SET status = 'WAITING', execMessage = NULL, attemptCount = 0, workerId = NULL, leaseExpireTime = NULL, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND userId = #{userId} AND isDelete = 0 AND UPPER(status) = 'FAILED'
UPDATE chart SET isDelete = 1, updateTime = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{chartId} AND isDelete = 0 AND (status IS NULL OR UPPER(status) <> 'RUNNING')
